resources.string: Share an X (x.com), TikTok, Bluesky or Reddit link to x2vx to copy it as an embed-friendly link without tracking parameters.
Used for x.com links. TikTok, Bluesky and Reddit links are converted to tnktok.com, fxbsky.app and vxreddit.com.
Translation is only available with fxtwitter.com and fixupx.com.
The link is always copied to the clipboard. When on, the share menu also opens so you can send it straight to another app.
